purpose: Teach: 大尉/同書/号証/線形/密集/細心/デモンストレーション/もとづく
target_vocab: デモンストレーション

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、機動隊の元大尉も指揮されますね
lines.en: The police department, with the former captain of the riot control unit in command, really does oversee everything, doesn't it?
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Measured pace, genuinely interested. Light emphasis on 'does oversee' — not sarcastic, actually recognizing competence. Warm but formal acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書で同書の参照を明確にされますね
lines.en: In their statements, the police make sure to clearly reference the relevant documents, don't they?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact tone. Slight upward lift at the end, seeking confirmation. Professional and straightforward — appreciating thoroughness without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、裁判所への号証提出を担当されますね
lines.en: The police handle the submission of evidence exhibits to the court, I understand.
lines.style: Calm, informational delivery. Gentle curiosity underneath — checking understanding. Slow enough to show thought. Respectful of the process being described.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行時刻の線形予測も活用されますね
lines.en: They really do make use of timeline analysis to pinpoint the time of the incident, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Warm recognition of detailed methodology. Even pace, slight emphasis on 'timeline' — admiring the precision without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、密集したデモを安全に警備されますね
lines.en: The police certainly do keep crowds safe during these demonstrations with careful crowd management, right?
lines.style: Measured, acknowledging difficulty. Respectful tone. Slight weight on 'carefully' — recognizing the real work involved. Not congratulatory, but genuinely recognizing competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査に細心の注意を払われますね
lines.en: During investigations, they really do exercise meticulous care and attention, don't they?
lines.style: Slower pace, reflecting the weight of the work. Quiet respect in the voice. Genuine acknowledgment of standards being upheld. Warm but professional throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯デモンストレーションを地域でおこなわれますね
lines.en: The police do conduct crime prevention demonstrations in local communities like this one, I see.
lines.style: Interested, genuinely curious tone. Slightly wondering emphasis. Appreciating the community-focused approach. Conversational but with underlying respect for the initiative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、判断は証拠にもとづく姿勢で一貫されますね
lines.en: Their judgments remain consistently grounded in evidence — that's the foundation they work from, isn't it?
lines.style: Firmer conviction here. Clear respect for the principle. Measured but with quiet emphasis on 'grounded in evidence.' The voice of someone affirming a standard that matters.
